أكتمل (form VIII)
# أَكْتَمِلُ (ʔaktamilu) /ʔak.ta.mi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِكْتَمَلَ (iktamala)
# أَكْتَمِلَ (ʔaktamila) /ʔak.ta.mi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَمَلَ (iktamala)
# أَكْتَمِلْ (ʔaktamil) /ʔak.ta.mil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِكْتَمَلَ (iktamala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
